gloss: bundling; packing together; including in the same package

definitions.gloss: bundling; packing together; including in the same package
definitions.explanation: Packaging multiple items together in the same box or shipment. Very common in e-commerce and product descriptions.

examples.japanese: {説明書|せつめいしょ}が{同梱|どうこん}されている。
examples.english: An instruction manual is included in the package.

examples.japanese: {二|ふた}つの{商品|しょうひん}を{同梱|どうこん}で{発送|はっそう}する。
examples.english: To ship the two items together in the same package.

examples.japanese: {同梱|どうこん}できる{場合|ばあい}は{送料|そうりょう}が{一回分|いっかいぶん}で{済|す}みます。
examples.english: If the items can be packed together, you only pay shipping once.

notes:
A word that has become extremely common with the rise of online shopping. Refers to packaging multiple items together in one shipment, or items that come included in a product's box.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {同梱|どうこん}{物|ぶつ}: items included in the package
- {同梱|どうこん}{発送|はっそう}: combined shipping
- {同梱|どうこん}{可能|かのう}: can be combined in one package
- {同梱|どうこん}{不可|ふか}: cannot be combined (must ship separately)
- {同梱|どうこん}{版|ばん}: bundled edition (software, games)

USAGE:
Very frequently seen on Japanese e-commerce sites (Amazon, Rakuten, Mercari) where sellers specify whether multiple purchases can be shipped together. Also used for items that come included with a product, such as accessories, manuals, or cables.

ETYMOLOGY:
{同|どう} (same, together) + {梱|こん} (pack, bale) — "packed together."
